description: Every sentence a wait is said in. delivery_state.waits fills each from the fields it derives, in journal_words' template forms; no view words a wait itself. A template may instead be {"by": field, "cases": {value: template}, "otherwise": template}.

stages.description: Where the story a wait names stands, by its stage in the record.

cases.handed: It waits for the lead to accept it.
cases.checked: It is checked and about to merge.

waits.description: A story's wait, by its cause.

templates.files: Waits for {on:ticket} to land. {onLane:lane} holds {files:list} for it.
templates.review: In review: round {round} under way at {head:commit}, {back} of {lenses:count:lens|lenses} back.

lanes.description: An idle lane whose next story waits, by that story's cause.

templates.order: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which waits for {on:ticket} to land.
templates.files: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which waits for {on:ticket} to land. {onLane:lane} holds {files:list} for it.
templates.held: {subject:lane} is next on {next:ticket}, which the lead holds: {text}

holding.description: Under the story others wait on.

needsYou.description: The two forms a wait reaches "Needs you" in, and the item for a stopped story no other item names.

templates.free: {subject:ticket} is free to start. {lane:lane} is idle.

listening.description: The "Needs you" item while no lead-wait runs and something needs the lead to listen: the lanes still at work, by name, the first as a sentence starts it.

cases.0: A piece in the queue can't reach the lead. If it lands or stops, nothing will tell the lead until it is watching again.
cases.1: {lanes:list} can't reach the lead. A hand-off or question from it will wait unseen until the lead is watching again.

text.otherwise: {lanes:list} can't reach the lead. A hand-off or question from them will wait unseen until the lead is watching again.
